memory_update.text: WEST is the cleanest public-market mapping for the private-label coffee, extracts, traceability, and beverage-solutions node, but later layers must test leverage, capex intensity, extract-facility utilization, customer concentration, and sustainable margins.

FARM and JVA have unusually direct coffee/foodservice/private-label exposure but are below the preferred market-cap range; keep them only as speculative shadow candidates until filings prove liquidity, profitability, and customer durability.

THS is a broader private-label manufacturer with possible beverage and coffee optionality; the next layer should determine whether coffee/tea/private-label beverage is material or merely a small tuck-in exposure.

The restaurant beverage supply-chain node appears to split into four public-market subnodes: integrated beverage solutions and extracts, DSD foodservice coffee distribution, private-label packaged beverage manufacturing, and niche wholesale roasting/green-coffee sourcing.

Commercial coffee equipment and service may be a real chokepoint, but BUNN is private after Ali Group's 2026 acquisition and many equipment specialists are private or embedded inside diversified foodservice equipment companies; later passes should search public equipment/service proxies separately.

node: Private-label coffee, extracts, and beverage solutions
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around private-label coffee, extracts, beverage solutions, and adjacent foodservice beverage infrastructure. The strongest direct mapping is Westrock Coffee, which explicitly positions itself as an integrated coffee, tea, flavors, extracts, and ingredients solutions provider for restaurant, foodservice, convenience, hospitality, CPG, and private-label customers. Farmer Brothers and Coffee Holding are much smaller, financially fragile or micro-cap candidates with direct coffee/foodservice/private-label exposure but require strict balance-sheet and customer verification. TreeHouse Foods is a broader private-label packaged-food and beverage manufacturer that may be a second-order beneficiary of retailer and foodservice private-brand growth, especially after Farmer Brothers sold it a coffee-related direct-ship business, but its coffee-specific exposure needs segmentation work. Reference context not included as candidates due to the underfollowed focus: Starbucks, Keurig Dr Pepper, McDonald's, Yum Brands, Domino's, and other restaurant chains can anchor end-demand, while private BUNN/Ali Group provides equipment context.
